name: pulsecheck
description: Image download speed tester and analytics dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @pulsecheck/api" "npm run dev -w @pulsecheck/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pulsecheck/api && npm run build -w @pulsecheck/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pulsecheck/api && npm run typecheck -w @pulsecheck/web
